title: Year 3 SPaG check (20 questions)
subject: English
source: Written for english/y3 lesson 88 (Teacher's SPaG check (20 questions on this year's Year 3 grammar, punctuation and spelling; in the portal and printable))
intro: Lesson 88. Answer every question. Then mark it with your teacher and write your next step.

questions.q: Add inverted commas: Look at the river! said Sam.
Choose the conjunction: I wore a coat ___ it was cold. (because / but)
Underline the noun: The heron caught a fish.
Underline the verb: The river flows to the sea.
Underline the adjective: The tall tree swayed.
Underline the adverb: She whispered quietly.
Write in the present perfect: We finish our report.
Add a prefix to make the opposite: happy
Add a prefix to make the opposite: agree
Add the suffix -ly: sad
Add the suffix -ous: danger
Choose: I can ___ the birds. (here / hear)
Choose: The ___ was hot. (sun / son)
a or an: ___ owl
Write the plural: bush
Add the missing full stop and capital letter: the meadow floods it is not safe
questions.a: The meadow floods. It is not safe.

questions.q: Choose the past tense: Yesterday we (swim / swam) in the river.
Use 'when' to join: The rain came. The river rose.
questions.a: When the rain came, the river rose. (or The river rose when the rain came.)

questions.q: Which word is a preposition? We walked under the bridge.
Correct the spelling: The famus waterfall is beutiful.
